messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — SLA breach detected for tenant final-mile-prod. Metric: request_latency_p95 > 5s for 12m. Paging #eng-oncall. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/boards/tenant-final-mile

maria: on it. seeing the page, will triage. anyone else seeing broad impact?

sanjay: quick check — looks very tenant-scoped. final-mile-prod only. p50 looks fine, p95 is spiking. Could be noisy customer check or bursty job.

kevin: i pulled traces, tail shows lots of small tail-latency spikes on model init for requests hitting long-prompts path. probably KV cache misses. correlate with the rollout we did to batching-v2?

maria: @sanjay @kevin thx. if it's correlated with batching-v2 rollout we should fallback for that tenant. can we route final-mile to batching-v1 immediately?

kevin: yep — can do a rollback route. applying temporary routing policy now: `redwood route set --tenant final-mile-prod --model-variant batching-v1 --reason "mitigate p95 spike" --ttl 30m`

ops-bot: ACTION TAKEN — route change requested by kevin. Change will take effect in ~30s.

eva: i can take the follow-up while maria stands this one down. creating INC ticket and assigning.

eva: created INC-8921, severity-high, assignee: eva, notes: "tenant-specific p95 spike after batching-v2 rollout; temporary route fallback applied; needs alert tuning and postmortem." linking dashboards.

julio: +1 on follow-up. proposed tuning: add a debounce for tenant-scoped SLA alerts and move aggregation window from 5m to 10m for p95 checks. That should reduce noise for high-variance tenants. Also add a per-tenant reduction threshold for synthetic checks.

maria: agree. let's also silence the noisy tenant-specific alert while we validate fallback. applying silence for 20m: `/alerts silence --filter "tenant:final-mile-prod AND alert:sla_breach" --duration 20m`

sanjay: after silence, we should create a saved dashboard and an alert-template change. sketch of the alert rule we'll push in infra repo:

```
alert: tenant_sla_p95
expr: max_over_time(request_latency_p95{tenant="$TENANT"}[10m]) > 6s
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
  tenant: "$TENANT"
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/tenant-sla-p95
```

julio: will add the debounce flag and a tenant-watchlist so we can opt-in customers that need tighter thresholds.

product-lucas: fyi — i looped in CS. FinalMile is in touch, they reported intermittent slow responses impacting order confirmation. they want ETA and mitigation notes.

maria: routing fallback confirmed applied, p95 dropping on grafana view. i'll keep the silence until we push alert rule changes + runbook. good handoff to @eva for postmortem + customer comms.

eva: got it. i'll draft a customer note and follow up with CS. putting a follow-up action in INC-8921: 'audit recent rollouts that touch batching-v2, add rollback gates for tenant impact'.

kevin: action items i'll do: 1) rollback routing already done; 2) open PR with alert rule change + debounce; 3) perf trace capture for final-mile during spike window.

maria: thanks team. closing loop here — will reopen if pager returns. adding retro item to next oncall rotation to sweep tenant noise rules. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (temporary mitigation) — route fallback in place, alert silenced. See INC-8921 for follow-up."
